_comment: Agent-native scope, verify, and spec pointers keyed by lcp-build-plan issue key (e.g. sprint-2/2.3). Used by generate-beads-build-queue.mjs.

constraints: Do not modify `.env*`, Supabase migrations, or CMS auth without explicit approval

steps: Confirm `latestcrazeproductions.com` URL-prefix property in Google Search Console
Document verification method in PR or `content-registry/` note if a file change is needed

scope: GitHub repository Settings → Secrets and variables → Actions
steps: Add `CURSOR_API_KEY` secret on the repo (team service account)
Confirm workflow files reference the secret name exactly
Run `seo-weekly-dry-run.yml` via workflow_dispatch to validate secret wiring (no cloud spend if dry-run)
phase-0/0.8.verify: GitHub Actions workflow_dispatch succeeds; secret present (do not log secret value)

steps: Set org/account spend limit before first live `seo-weekly.yml` run
Record limit amount in Linear comment (not in repo)
phase-0/0.9.verify: Cursor dashboard shows configured spend limit; note date in Linear issue

steps: Run orchestrator dry-run to pick a service refresh task
Dispatch ServiceRefreshAgent (cloud) for FAQ + visible date touch on one service page
Open PR with `.github/pull_request_template/seo-agent.md`; human merges to trigger Vercel
sprint-2/2.3.verify: One agent PR merged to `development` (or `main` per workflow); page shows updated FAQ/date

steps: Ensure Phase 0 engineering gates complete (0.8, 0.9)
Enable live weekly workflow with `--max-tasks 1`
Monitor first run; confirm PR opened and QA gate passes
sprint-2/2.4.verify: Scheduled or manual `seo-weekly.yml` run completes green with `--max-tasks 1`

steps: Manual workflow_dispatch for Phase 1 national content build
Confirm nationwide hub URLs marked `live` in registry
Human review extended PR batch before merge
sprint-4/4.2.verify: Phase 1 build workflow green; nationwide hub live in registry and sitemap

steps: Trigger Phase 2 ten-city pilot build (manual only)
Confirm 10 pilot cities in `sites.json` match leadership list
Run bulk QA; resolve cannibalization flags before merge
sprint-4/4.3.verify: 10 pilot city pages live ≥30 days with no open cannibalization QA failures

steps: Run QA suite against expanded registry after phase build
Fix or ticket any error-severity QA issues before steady-state
sprint-4/4.4.verify: `npm test` in `scripts/seo-orchestrator` passes; QA report has zero error-severity issues on expanded registry
